final: SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee) AS ShareOfTotal, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee) - 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ReportsTo) AS DifferenceFromAverageShare FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo ORDER BY DifferenceFromAverageShare DESC LIMIT 10
